background: Bank of Scotland plc is one of the ring-fenced banks of Lloyds Banking Group, trading as Bank of Scotland and Halifax, funded by UK retail deposits and lending mainly on residential mortgages.
synthesis: Rated AA- on average across all three, the weakest of them at A+, all three on a stable outlook after a one-notch upgrade by one of the three on 12 May 2026, the ratings sit at the bottom of the double-A range. Capital is adequate rather than ample: CET1 of 14.1% is above the peer median, but leverage of 4.5% is in the bottom quarter and is the weak spot. Liquidity is mixed, with LCR of 144% level with the peer median and NSFR of 123% below it, while CET1 has risen 0.7 points since 30 Jun 2024 and the other ratios have been broadly flat. The newest flagged item, on 9 Oct 2026, is an online banking outage shared with the rest of the group, an operational rather than a credit matter.
